author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Prepping the pipe is the most important step. I deburr the inside and outside of the pipe. Then I mark the depth, add the escutcheon and push the shutoff on. These SharkBite push-to-connect angle stops are fantastic and I use them all the time for bathroom sinks
